definition: Whether SME employers use technologies or web-based software to sell to customers or manage the business.
measurement_method: Percentage of SME employers using such technologies, by business size and sector.
data_source_text: In the data tables accompanying this publication, tables 8 and 9 (Cohort C) show technology use.
evidence_quote: In 2024, 69% of all SME employers used technologies or web-based software to sell to customers or to manage the business.

report_title: Longitudinal Small Business Survey 2024: SME employers (businesses with 1 to 249 employees) - GOV.UK
raw_variable_name: Women-led businesses
definition: Businesses majority-led by women, either controlled by a single woman or having a management team majority women.
measurement_method: Percentage of SME employers classified as women-led.
data_source_text: In the data tables accompanying this publication, tables 34 and 35 show whether the business is classified as women-led.
evidence_quote: In 2024, 14% of SME employers were women-led. This was a one percentage point decrease on 2023 and a four percentage points decrease on 2022.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Annual real growth rate of VA from digitalisation
definition: Estimated annual real growth rate of value added from digitalisation activities in Singapore's economy.
measurement_method: Estimated using a deflator derived from real GDP, nominal GDP, and compensation of employees components to approximate real Gross Operating Surplus.
data_source_text: The annual real growth rate was estimated to be between 3% and 4% as compared to real GDP growth of 1.1% in 2023.
evidence_quote: The annual real growth rate was estimated to be between 3% and 4% as compared to real GDP growth of 1.1% in 2023.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Average cost savings per firm per PSG application
definition: Average cost savings reported by SMEs adopting digital solutions under the Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG) during 2018 to 2023.
measurement_method: Self-declared business outcomes from PSG applicants after adopting digital solutions.
data_source_text: SMEs that adopted digital solutions under the Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG) have reported cost savings of around 50% on average during the period of 2018 to 2023.
evidence_quote: SMEs that adopted digital solutions under the Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG) have reported cost savings of around 50% on average during the period of 2018 to 2023.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Digital adoption intensity among enterprises
definition: Average number of digital areas adopted per firm, out of six digital areas examined.
measurement_method: Calculated as average count of digital areas adopted per firm from survey or administrative data.
data_source_text: Digital adoption intensity reached 2.0 in 2023, up from 1.9 in 2022.
evidence_quote: Digital adoption intensity ... reaching 2.0 last year, up from 1.9 in 2022.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Digital adoption rate among enterprises
definition: Percentage of firms adopting at least one out of six digital areas: Cybersecurity, Cloud, E-payment, E-commerce, Data Analytics, and AI.
measurement_method: Calculated as percentage of firms adopting at least one digital area from survey or administrative data.
data_source_text: Digital adoption rate among all enterprises rose by 0.5 percentage point to reach 94.6% in 2023.
evidence_quote: Digital adoption rate among all enterprises ... reached 94.6% in 2023.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: I&C sector nominal VA
definition: The nominal value added (VA) of the Information & Communications (I&C) sector in Singapore's digital economy.
measurement_method: Measured as nominal value added in Singapore dollars (S$) from official statistics published by DOS.
data_source_text: In this report, the latest available statistics for I&C sector as published by DOS were used.
evidence_quote: The sector’s nominal VA amounted to S$36.3 billion in 2023, and its share of the economy rose to 5.7% of GDP

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Median monthly wages for resident tech workers
definition: Median gross monthly wages (excluding employer CPF contributions and bonuses) of full-time resident tech workers in Singapore.
measurement_method: Median monthly wages derived from Occupational Wage Survey by MOM.
data_source_text: Median monthly wages for resident tech workers grew at a CAGR of 4.0% between 2018 and 2023, with median wage at S$7,000 in 2023.
evidence_quote: Median monthly wages for resident tech workers ... remained much higher at S$7,000 compared to the median monthly wages for overall resident workers of S$4,550 in 2023.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Nominal VA from digitalisation in the rest of the economy
definition: The nominal value added from digitalisation activities outside the I&C sector in Singapore's economy.
measurement_method: Measured as nominal value added in Singapore dollars (S$) derived from Gross Operating Surplus (GOS) component of GDP.
data_source_text: The nominal VA from digitalisation in the rest of the economy came in at S$76.9 billion in 2023, accounting for 12.0% of GDP.
evidence_quote: The nominal VA from digitalisation in the rest of the economy came in at S$76.9 billion in 2023, accounting for 12.0% of GDP.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Number of tech jobs in Singapore
definition: Total number of technology-related jobs in Singapore.
measurement_method: Count of tech jobs based on classification of tech-related occupations from MOM data.
data_source_text: The number of tech jobs in Singapore rose by 3.4% from 201,400 in 2022 to 208,300 in 2023.
evidence_quote: The number of tech jobs in Singapore rose by 3.4% from 201,400 in 2022 to 208,300 in 2023.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Share of nominal VA from digitalisation in the rest of the economy as % of GDP
definition: The share of nominal value added from digitalisation in the rest of the economy as a percentage of Singapore's GDP.
measurement_method: Calculated as (Nominal VA from digitalisation in rest of economy / Singapore GDP) * 100%.
data_source_text: The nominal VA from digitalisation in the rest of the economy came in at S$76.9 billion in 2023, accounting for 12.0% of GDP.
evidence_quote: The nominal VA from digitalisation in the rest of the economy came in at S$76.9 billion in 2023, accounting for 12.0% of GDP.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Share of SMEs adopting at least one digital solution for general business functions
definition: Percentage of SMEs that adopted at least one digital solution addressing general business functions such as Accounting Management, Human Resources Management, Customer Relationship Management, Collaboration Tools.
measurement_method: Calculated as percentage of SMEs adopting at least one such digital solution from survey data.
data_source_text: The share of SMEs that adopted at least one digital solution for general business functions rose from 69% in 2021 to 82% in 2023.
evidence_quote: The share of SMEs that adopted at least one digital solution for general business functions rose steadily from 69% in 2021 to 82% in 2023.

report_title: SINGAPORE DIGITAL ECONOMY REPORT
raw_variable_name: Tech jobs as % of total employment
definition: Proportion of technology-related jobs as a percentage of total employment in Singapore.
measurement_method: Calculated as (Number of tech jobs / Total employment) * 100%.
data_source_text: Tech jobs accounted for 5.2% of total employment in 2023, similar to that in 2022.
evidence_quote: Tech jobs accounted for 5.2% of total employment in 2023, similar to that in 2022.
